sentences.text: Været i Bergen er ofte vått. Men sola er også ute.
sentences.english: The weather in Bergen is often wet. But the sun is also out.

sentences.text: I Bergen regner det ofte.
sentences.english: In Bergen it often rains.

sentences.text: Folk sier: «Det regner alltid i Bergen!»
sentences.english: People say: "It always rains in Bergen!"

sentences.text: Men det regner ikke alltid. Mange dager er sola ute.
sentences.english: But it does not always rain. Many days the sun is out.

sentences.text: I dag regner det. Det er vått.
sentences.english: Today it is raining. It is wet.

sentences.text: Været er ikke bra i dag.
sentences.english: The weather is not good today.

sentences.text: Sam vil gå til skolen. Han tar paraplyen.
sentences.english: Sam wants to go to the school. He takes the umbrella.

sentences.text: Det er ikke varmt i dag, Sam. Ta jakka di!
sentences.english: It is not warm today, Sam. Take your jacket!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, jeg tar jakka.
sentences.english: Yes, I will take the jacket.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Er det varmt i USA?
sentences.english: Is it warm in the USA?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, det er ofte varmt. Det regner ikke mye.
sentences.english: Yes, it is often warm. It does not rain much.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Regn er vann. Vann er bra!
sentences.english: Rain is water. Water is good!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Sam går ut. Det regner mye. Paraplyen er bra.
sentences.english: Sam goes out. It rains a lot. The umbrella is good.

sentences.text: Jeg er våt, men jeg er glad!
sentences.english: I am wet, but I am happy!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Det regner. Anna og Lars er hjemme i dag.
sentences.english: It is raining. Anna and Lars are at home today.

sentences.text: Jeg er trøtt. Vil du ha te, Anna?
sentences.english: I am tired. Do you want tea, Anna?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Ja, gjerne! Jeg vil ha te med melk.
sentences.english: Yes, please! I want tea with milk.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Vi er hjemme, og vi drikker te. Det er bra.
sentences.english: We are at home, and we drink tea. That is good.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Jeg liker regn i dag.
sentences.english: I like rain today.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg vil ha brød med ost. Vil du ha brød, Anna?
sentences.english: I want bread with cheese. Do you want bread, Anna?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Ja, gjerne! Takk, Lars.
sentences.english: Yes, please! Thanks, Lars.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Dagen etter er sola ute!
sentences.english: The next day the sun is out!

sentences.text: Det er ikke vått. Været er bra i dag.
sentences.english: It is not wet. The weather is good today.

sentences.text: Nils kommer til Sam. Han har ikke jakka i dag.
sentences.english: Nils comes to Sam. He does not have a jacket today.

sentences.text: Sola er ute, Sam!
sentences.english: The sun is out, Sam!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja! I dag vil jeg ikke ha paraply.
sentences.english: Yes! Today I do not want an umbrella.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Vi går ut!
sentences.english: Let's go out!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Folk er glade i dag. Mange går til markedet.
sentences.english: People are happy today. Many go to the market.

sentences.text: Marta er på markedet. Hun selger brød.
sentences.english: Marta is at the market. She sells bread.

sentences.text: Været i Bergen er ikke alltid bra, men folk er glade i byen.
sentences.english: The weather in Bergen is not always good, but people are fond of their town.

sentences.text: Sam har penger, og han vil kjøpe epler. Brød er billig, men jakka er dyr. Han betaler og er glad.
sentences.english: Sam has money, and he wants to buy apples. Bread is cheap, but the jacket is expensive. He pays and is happy.

sentences.text: I regnet hjelper Anna pasienter på klinikken. Marta baker brød. Det er bra.
sentences.english: In the rain Anna helps patients at the clinic. Marta bakes bread. That is a good job.

sentences.text: Sam tar bussen til sentrum. Bussen stopper på busstoppet.
sentences.english: Sam takes the bus to the town centre. The bus stops at the bus stop.

sentences.text: Sam synger en sang i regnet. Han vet: Gud elsker alle.
sentences.english: Sam sings a song in the rain. He knows: God loves everyone.
